The selected 58 project records and 515 native table plus 14 received-native entries are intended to be combined; duplicate destinations are rejected. Original byte metadata is followed by the guarded current-input check before normal. The known raw-receipt schema issue below prevents this version from implementing that intended join.

Three embedded postimages equal the delivered config files. The only build require is mathlib; goldbach is absent from the new manifest. Single target roots/globs are asserted, original config bytes are preserved, and the new .lake/packages link reuses the existing package store. The fixed Lake API makes this necessary to avoid goldbach preceding the new project namespace. Actual resolution remains a runtime gate.

The already received Unit128 archive is read locally and authenticated in full. capture_members accepts only three explicitly pinned regular members, rejects duplicate requested members, verifies each exact size/hash, writes them only under the new base, and preserves them. No Unit archive redownload or old graph parse occurs.

The action directory is a new real Git repository. Commands fetch the fixed official f061402b660e0c34644504b324e830f2991d4865 commit, detach FETCH_HEAD, check actual HEAD, and verify all five accepted script hashes. The code does not fake a .git/HEAD or call five copied files a checkout. Actual checkout/network success is untested.

Seven resource functions mechanically retain the approved v4 behavior, with only datetime module qualification. The hidden-cgroup branch requires exact observed root membership and no cgroup2 mount row; it binds the service JSON and namespace/mount identity and explicitly describes 50ms sampled aggregate RSS rather than a hard cgroup limit. Visible-cgroup branch and conservative cache deductions remain present. New constants are MCP12800MiB/2threads/3600s and original guard inner12288MiB, leaving512MiB nominal process margin. This is not a reservation or OOM/completion guarantee.

A resource check precedes creation of the exclusive attempt root, and another occurs before original guard setup/first Lean with identical cgroup binding required. Disk floor is368MiB estimated new output plus64MiB remaining. A capacity stop is not automatically retried.

The original guard setup, original runner and original owned parser are used. Runtime/version/prefix checks precede the first actual import probe; normal is a direct unique-target Lean command with warningAsError=true, followed by consumer imports, named kernel and full-owned. Final guard-log inspection requires exactly that source invocation; no source trace/setup is synthesized. This review does not re-audit root-owned qualification semantics.

An owned attempt retains partial target outputs and writes its failure only once when its own base exists. A prewrite failure is printed without creating the attempt root. No automatic retry or supplier replay path is introduced.
